title: Longest-Queue Policies in Dynamic Matching with Abandonments
abstract: arXiv:2611.01431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a dynamic two-way matching market in which agents of heterogeneous types arrive over time, wait to be matched according to a compatibility network, and abandon the system if their random patience expires. The decision maker collects match rewards and pays holding and abandonment costs, and seeks to maximize the expected net value over a finite horizon. We evaluate policies by their approximation ratio against a fluid benchmark, the optimal value of a linear-programming relaxation that upper bounds the expected net value of every policy. Under a general position gap (GPG) condition, which requires the unique optimal dual solution of this linear program to remain optimal under small perturbations of the arrival rates, we propose a longest-queue policy. translated_title: 带放弃行为的动态匹配中的最长队列策略
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个动态双向匹配市场，其中异质类型的主体随时间不断到达，根据兼容性网络等待匹配，并在其随机耐心耗尽时离开系统。决策者获得匹配收益，同时支付等待持有成本和放弃成本，目标是在有限时域内最大化期望净值。我们通过策略相对于一个流体基准的近似比来评估各策略，该流体基准是一个线性规划松弛的最优值，它为任意策略的期望净值提供了上界。在一般位置间隔条件下——即要求该线性规划的唯一最优对偶解在到达率发生微小扰动时仍保持最优——我们提出了一种最长队列策略。该策略首先利用此对偶解识别出一组“好”的匹配类型和一组“关键”的主体类型。每当有新主体到达时，该策略仅考虑好的匹配类型，并匹配……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 针对存在异质主体、随机耐心与放弃行为的动态双向匹配市场，本文在一般位置间隔（GPG）条件下提出了一种基于线性规划对偶解的最长队列策略，并以流体基准上界为标准评估其近似性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a longest-queue policy for dynamic two-way matching markets with heterogeneous agents and abandonments, which leverages the optimal dual solution of a fluid LP relaxation under a general position gap condition and is evaluated by its approximation ratio against the fluid benchmark.
